 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # A colored object above a horizontal support line drops one row when
    # the row below it is clear; its former top row becomes the trail color.
    support_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 2]
    if not support_rows:
        return g
    sr = support_rows[0]
    bg = next((v for row in g for v in row if v not in (2,)), 0)
    # Identify the non-background object between the top and support.
    colors = {v for row in g[:sr] for v in row if v != bg}
    colors.discard(2)
    if not colors:
        return g
    obj = max(colors, key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in g[:sr] for v in row))
    coords = [(r, c) for r in range(sr) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == obj]
    if not coords:
        return g
    # Move one cell down only if no object cell would hit the support/other content.
    if any(r + 1 >= sr or g[r + 1][c] not in (bg, obj) for r, c in coords):
        return g
    old_top = min(r for r, _ in coords)
    for r, c in coords:
        g[r][c] = bg
    for r, c in coords:
        g[r + 1][c] = obj
    for c in range(w):
        g[old_top][c] = 8
    return g

if __name__ == '__main__':
    # Demo pair regression check and current test output are run externally.
